author: Nintendo of America
description:
The Splatoon Raiders game launches July 23, 2026, only on the Nintendo Switch 2 system. 

Splat scores of enemies with colored ink and go treasure hunting in #SplatoonRaiders, a new single-player-focused game! Play as a mechanic working with Deep Cut, a trio of swashbuckling musicians, and venture out into the mysterious Spirhalite Islands! Customize your appearance, equip mechanical gadgets and ink-splattering weapons, and take on hordes of aggressive sea creatures called Salmonids in search of treasure. 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/splatoon-raiders-switch-2/
